note: Per-ground-class tyre behaviour beyond the profile's peak-grip multiplier (profile tuning.surfaces). side_stiffness scales Rapier's side_friction_stiffness (the share of a wheel's sideways velocity its tyre pushes back per tick, so below 1 the car slides further and more progressively before the grip limit); rolling_resistance is force per newton of wheel load; speed_drag adds force per newton of load per m/s of the wheel's ground speed (soft ground plows harder the faster it goes). Tarmac rolling_resistance is 0: bitumen's rolling loss is the profile's linear_damping, so only the other grounds add drag on top of it (adding it to tarmac made jump landings in the R122/jump bank marginal).
